reply_text:
Thanks for telling me, Nadia. I won't pass the Albany/Bluefin news to Ruth or anyone else, and I won't put it in any channel. I'm treating it as between us.

If you think Ruth should hear it, the right route is for you or Mateo to brief her directly. If it would help, I can work through how to raise it with her, but I won't bring it up myself.
